about: Package 5's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/50-models.mjs, scope models: the engine panel, the VRAM meter, the dropdown), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison; so does a count that changes.

accepted.why: Deviation 27: ACE-Step's card says ×8 and "Up to 8 songs per Generate", the most takes the definitions give it (the server takes 8 at most); the concept says 9.
The panel's shots differ in ACE-Step's ×8 (deviation 27) and nothing else (both shots are in tools/visual-baseline/out/*-models/shots).
The model list's shot: the list is the same; what shows through at its rounded corners is the page behind it, where the concept has Latest's song art (package 6) and the rebuild its seam.

HeartMuLa's mark's gradient (id hmRainbow) in its card, the same markup on both pages: while HeartMuLa is not the engine in use, its id is unique on the rebuild's page, so the recorder keys it by its id, outside the scope's paths; on the concept's page a revision's engine mark in the Workflows panel (package 7) carries the same id, so it is keyed by its path.

A model list's quantisation chip takes no line height (styles/rebuild/15-models.css): the page is in standards mode, where the chip's line box would take the strut of its button's font, two pixels taller than its badge; in the concept's quirks mode it is as tall as its badge. The chips' size and place are the concept's.
